findings.title: Preserve the visible payment label beneath the finish asset
findings.body: The updated PNG covers the entire “Pay $49.00” label, leaving a blank green checkout button. In index.html:7, `.payment .finish` fills the button and sits above its text at z-index:2. Running `npm test` at base and head and viewing both `/tmp/checkout.png` artifacts confirms the label is visible only at base. Clicking still confirms the order, but sighted users lose the payment action and price at the point of confirmation. Restore transparency in the asset so the label remains visible.

findings.title: Preserve version-aware ordering in latest()
findings.body: Removing key=Version makes max() compare version strings lexicographically, selecting older releases or prereleases over newer stable releases. Running `/workspace/.venv/bin/python -` with calls to latest() on both revisions confirmed that head returns '1.9' for ['1.9', '1.10'], '2.0' for ['2.0', '10.0'], and '2.0rc1' for ['2.0rc1', '2.0']; base correctly returns '1.10', '10.0', and '2.0'. Restore version-aware comparison so callers receive the latest release.
